verdict.rationale: Cognee's MCP evidence covers only the server role: it exposes its memory to MCP-compatible assistants like Claude, Cursor and Cline. Nothing shows Cognee acting as an MCP client that connects to external MCP servers to use their tools. Its data-source integrations (Slack, GitHub, Linear) are first-party connectors, not MCP-client support, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
